newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria tenders for 75,000T opt wheat -official.
newsitem.headline: Algeria tenders for 75,000T opt wheat -official.

text.p: Algeria launched a tender to import 75,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat, said an Algerian official on Tuesday.

"There is no confirmation (of tender results) yet as we continue working on it," said a senior official in the Algerian Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales (OAIC), who was speaking by telephone from Algiers. He gave no further details.

European traders said earlier Algeria was seeking to import 50,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between February 25 and March 10 and another 25,000 tonnes for shipment in the first half of March.
